rules: At most one active task per project key.
Different project keys may run in parallel on the same Host.
A claimed task must show START/RUNNING evidence within 60 seconds or enter immediate handoff diagnosis.
Audio/video jobs are not declared stale by a fixed 10-minute rule after START; use media-duration-aware time budgets and file-progress evidence.
Never create a duplicate task for the same project while an earlier task is active unless the earlier task is explicitly canceled or terminal.
